# OpenDating

> Privacy-focused dating on an open protocol

A pre-release dating client built on Nostr and the OpenDating protocol. Exact GPS is converted to a coarse area on-device and direct messages are end-to-end encrypted. Current services are operated by OpenDating on Cloudflare; federation is post-GA work.

## What it is
- Category: dating app
- Platforms: iOS, Android
- Price: Free
- Built for: people who want genuine dating without surveillance capitalism

## Key properties
- Cryptographic account identity — a native signer and safe recovery are still production blockers
- Coarse location only — your exact GPS never reaches the server
- End-to-end encrypted message content — the current relay does not receive plaintext
- Private likes — one-way likes are never public
- Private blocks and reports — enforced server-side, never notified
- No ads, no data harvesting, no surveillance business model
- Experimental account portability through a recovery key; passkey recovery and cross-provider portability are not GA-ready
